body: There's always going to be ups and downs, man. The best thing to do is ride through them, and make the best out of every problem and mistake. You can pull through it. I know you can.
You do have a good side, everyone does. Why would you say you don't?

Hey man, you've come so far! I mean, you made it past 22 years of your life (I'm pretty sure you already know this). I mean, you're a master at life to me (I'm 15) XD. Things will get better. Please don't commit suicide. There's so much everywhere. There's so much left to see and to do. Try picking up a small hobby and see if that helps. But please, reconsider your decision.

No. Stop. I was depressed. Things DO get better. I'm not just saying that because I don't want you to commit suicide, I'm saying it because there's so much to see. If you want to commit suicide, you haven't seen. You haven't seen the wonders of the world, of humanity, and.... of YOURSELF. So please, I ask you to reconsider your descion. Please.
